concerns.text: FR-001 defines `adolescent_exposure_ratio` as the ratio of listens during adolescence to total listens, requiring per‑user listen timestamps. Section 6 states the data source is the Million Song Dataset, which does NOT contain individual listening events or timestamps, only track‑level metadata. Consequently the primary predictor cannot be computed from the cited data, rendering the core hypothesis untestable with the proposed dataset.

FR-005 includes both `adolescent_exposure_ratio` and `total_listens` as separate fixed‑effect predictors. Since the ratio is mathematically defined as `listens_adolescence / total_listens`, the two predictors are inherently collinear. Even though FR-003 mandates VIF checks, the model specification still relies on a dependent predictor structure, which can bias coefficient estimates and invalidate inference about the exposure effect.
